body: - G-Wire-1 deviation: the non-crash finalize success path in ci_fixer_lane.py renames its machine-consumed output token from STATUS=complete to STATUS=closed, but the new test test_fixer_lane_main_persists_run_b_after_valid_run_a (added in the same diff, python/tests/implement/test_ci.py) asserts the string "STATUS=complete\nRESULT=retry-next-tool", a consumer of the changed grammar that was not updated with the renamed token. The assertion would fail in CI. G-Wire-1 requires preserving byte-compatibility for existing readers or updating every consumer in the same change; the renamed token was not swept to all consumers introduced in this diff.
